summary: Mock sitcom title sequence: a painted title card on a wallpapered wall, then a pan along five framed pictures each playing short clips of the host and guest, ending by pushing into the last picture where the guest is yelling.
framing: Starts with the title card filling the frame; pulls straight back to show it as a framed picture on a brown woven wallpaper, then tracks right at constant speed along a staggered row of framed pictures (alternating high and low, corners overlapping); the last, upper-right picture enlarges on its own until it fills the frame.
props: six pictures in orange wood frames with a red inner line, staggered high/low and overlapping at the corners; each lower picture sits in front of its upper neighbours
title card painting with purple script lettering and two head portraits

beats.action: holds on the title card filling the frame, no border visible
the card's wood frame fades in around the edges of the screen without the artwork changing size
pulls straight back from the card, wallpaper appearing around it; fast at first, easing out by about 905
P2's frame edge enters at the top right
starts drifting right while the pull-back finishes, reaching a constant pan speed by about 904; pans right along the pictures
P3's frame edge enters at the right
P2 cuts from the host grooming inside his office to the host greeting the guest at the office door
P4's frame edge enters at the top right
P4 cuts from the over-the-shoulder corridor view to the wide view of the crowd charging at the two men
P5's frame edge enters at the right
P4 cuts to the floor-level close-up of the guest being trampled
P6's frame edge enters at the top right
P5 cuts from the host pointing at the guest's jacket to the doorway scene with the green snake-like creature
P6 starts growing on its own, slowly at first and from about 1125 quickly, expanding down and to the left over P5 and P4 while the pan continues
P6 cuts from the bar scene to the grey-wall close-up of the guest
P6 fills the frame, no border or wall left; holds on the guest close-up

notes: All cuts in this shot happen inside pictures, not on the full frame, so hidden_cut is null. Picture contents are full-motion clips; frame numbers inside 'pictures' are absolute source frames. A vignette's 'f' is the first frame its content is on screen (the picture may still be mostly out of frame); 'f_end' is the last frame it is on screen. P6's last vignette runs straight on into the next shot's action. The title card is a still except for the host portrait's mouth. P5 is hidden behind P6 from 1168.

vignettes.setting: Painted title card on a flat pinkish-cream ground. Lettering in dark purple brush script with a darker outline, all slanting upward to the right by roughly 20 degrees, three lines: 'Skinner' (large, capital S) in the upper centre-right; '& the' (small) just below it, centred; 'Superintendent' (large, tall looping capital S starting at lower left) running from lower left to the right edge. Two head portraits: upper left, the host's head 3/4 right, head tilted, toothy smile, half-lidded eyes looking down-right, lilac shirt collar, right fist with thumb pointing back at himself below his chin; lower right, the guest's head 3/4 left, half-lidded eyes, mouth a flat frown, white collar and red tie knot. Thin orange-and-red wood frame around the card.
